The setting is an outdoor plaza at dusk with warm artificial lighting. (2) A montage showing white minarets and a Saudi Arabian flag against a bright blue sky. Crowds of people dressed in traditional white robes (thobes) walk through the vast courtyard of a mosque. (3) Night scenes within a mosque complex feature giant illuminated white pillars and arches with black-and-white stripes. The host is seen talking indoors with people blurred in the background. (4) The host, now without the niqab but still in a knitted cap, walks outdoors and talks with a male partner in a white thobe. They are in a sunny urban area with traditional architecture. (5) An interview segment shows the host speaking to a bearded man wearing sunglasses on a city street. (6) Visual footage of a massive crowd of worshippers in a plaza at night, followed by a daytime shot of pigeons taking flight in a square. (7) Various shots of famous mosques including the Al-Masjid an-Nabawi with its green dome. (8) A teaser for the next episode shows the host in a desert landscape with white sheep and a dusty road under a hazy sky.
